verses.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

segments.text: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.text: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

segments.text: Which imagine mischiefs in
their
heart; continually are they gathered together
for
war.

verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

segments.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison
is
under their lips. Selah.

verses.text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

segments.text: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

segments.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.text: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

segments.text: I said unto the LORD, Thou
art
my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

verses.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

segments.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

segments.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device;
lest
they exalt themselves. Selah.

notes: 140.8 lest…: or, let them not be exalted

verses.text: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

segments.text: As for
the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

segments.text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.text: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

segments.text: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow
him

notes: 140.11 an…: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow

verses.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

segments.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
and
the right of the poor.

verses.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

segments.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
